name: Eduardo de Miguel Vázquez
evidence: GitHub code search for "Eduardo de Miguel" returned ~1500 hits, but essentially all are a different person: an Odoo/OCA developer at Moduon (edu@moduon.team) appearing in l10n-spain, sale-workflow and stock-logistics CONTRIBUTORS files. No link to Deusto Business School or corporate relations, so the namesake rule rules that address out. One WebSearch on 'Eduardo de Miguel Deusto Business School Madrid corporate relations email' returned only Deusto programme and campus pages - no staff-directory page among the results - and the only address the search surfaced (eduardo.demiguel@deusto.es) is exactly the institution's firstname.lastname template and did not appear in any quoted page snippet, so it cannot be treated as printed evidence. A direct curl to the Deusto Madrid headquarters page was refused by the egress proxy (403 CONNECT), so the claim could not be checked. Marking not found rather than risk a constructed address.
